_doc: Job registry. tier S = sandbox (single CPU, minutes, run by the analysis side); tier X = server (parallel / hours / large memory, run by the user). Every X job has a smoke variant that must pass in the sandbox before hand-off.

verify-core.cmd: python3 scripts/s1_build_qlr.py --variant pure28 --workers 4 && python3 scripts/s2_judge.py QLR_H_pure28.npy && python3 scripts/s3_rank19.py QLR_H_pure28.npy && python3 scripts/s12_dfz_reconcile.py
verify-core.checks: s2 violated 0; s3 18/19 with only #19 at rank 29; s12 PSITIP-INCOMPLETE

a1-campaign.smoke: python3 scripts/s4c_qlr.py --init data/qlr_seeds60.npy --state smoke_adj.npy && python3 scripts/s4c_qlr.py --state smoke_adj.npy --budget 40 --rep-timeout 30 --max-tight 120 --workers 2
a1-campaign.checks: growth.csv rows increase; STATE line printed; no 'bad' counts; all new orbits certified on the spot

server-batch.smoke: python3 scripts/s1_build_qlr.py --variant pure28 --workers 4 && python3 scripts/s7_expand_realizable.py --H QLR_H_pure28.npy --f3-limit 20000 --gf2-samples 200000 && python3 scripts/s10_facets.py --H QLR_H_pure28.npy --limit 2
server-batch.checks: s7 pure violations 0 twice; s10 facet classes 31 redundant 53

mplrs-completeness.cmd: python3 scripts/s4_clr_prepare.py && mpirun -np 25 mplrs clr5.ine clr5.mplrs.out
mplrs-completeness.checks: then python3 scripts/s5_orbits.py clr5.mplrs.out --expect 162 -> MATCH (optional luxury)
